correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and a cyclic shift plus b(n-1)=0, H(i,j)=nd-i for 2(j-i)<n and (n+1)(n-(j-i))-n-i otherwise. Direct boundary casework at j=n-1 shows no transition lowers H by more than one and exactly one letter lowers it by one, including the n=2 degenerate boundary. Rank intervals for d and n-d partition 1..n(n-1)/2, so each rank occurs once. The unique maximal pair follows a rank-decreasing Hamiltonian path, giving one master word with all optimal suffixes. Independent reverse BFS was recomputed on all 2300 pairs through n=24; all agree. The general n result follows from the rank-descent proof.
